additional_info.body:
Dear Jeanne Mazenc,
We have observed that the charger is currently limited to 50 kW due to its configuration. The maximum power this charger can provide is 180 kW without any configuration restrictions. Could you please specify the desired power output for the charger? Please note that this power setting will apply equally to both outlets.
Best regards,
Mora, Catalina (SI E CS SD ES)
